$comment: One row per link supplied by the program owner. `supplied_*` is what we were given, untouched. `observed_*` is what this project saw when it followed that link on 2026-11-20. The two are never merged: a token in a link path is not an ASIN unless someone inside the enrolled account confirms it.
resolution_method: Server-side fetch that follows redirects (Arena verification fetch tool), no cookies, no Associates sign-in, US datacenter egress. Not a browser session, so a destination that varies by session or marketplace could differ; re-run from the enrolled account per RUNBOOK.md §2.

summary.observation: The four resolved destinations use a ten-character identifier in the /dp/ path and a different nine-character token in the supplied link. On that evidence the supplied token is a redirect code, not the catalog identifier of the page it landed on. Whether that is correct behaviour for a link.amazon code, or a paste error, cannot be settled from outside the account: FLG-003.
